exact: Income: revenue plus joint-venture/associate profit plus interest/other income equals total revenue and other income; expenditure, tax, and shareholder/non-controlling-interest attribution bridges all agree exactly.
Balance sheet: non-current assets plus current assets plus held-for-sale assets equals total assets; liabilities and equity bridges agree exactly.

Cash flow: operating, investing, financing, and FX totals bridge exactly to net cash change; opening cash plus net change equals closing cash and the balance-sheet cash value; cash capital expenditure equals the three disclosed investment components.
